{"id":14,"company":"Ideanomics, Inc.","risk_score":80,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"SEC action over misleading statements and revenue; later restatements and material weaknesses, FY2018 revenue questioned"},
{"id":15,"company":"Archer-Daniels-Midland Company","risk_score":55,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Nutrition segment intersegment transactions investigation; restated segment results for 2021-2023 and SEC probe, FY2022 affected"},
{"id":16,"company":"CPI Aerostructures, Inc.","risk_score":85,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated 2018 and prior for revenue recognition on long-term contracts; SEC enforcement later"},
{"id":17,"company":"Visteon Corporation","risk_score":10,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known restatement for FY2017"},
{"id":18,"company":"AerSale Corporation","risk_score":15,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"SPAC-merged company; no known restatement beyond warrant issues in SPAC period"},
{"id":19,"company":"Ducommun Incorporated","risk_score":10,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known accounting problems"},
{"id":20,"company":"Evoqua Water Technologies Corp.","risk_score":55,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated FY2018 and other periods for errors; SEC investigation and later settlement"},
{"id":21,"company":"National Presto Industries, Inc.","risk_score":10,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"Earlier Investment Company Act issue unrelated to 2022 statements"},
{"id":22,"company":"Adamis Pharmaceuticals Corporation","risk_score":50,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated earlier periods, SEC investigation and material weaknesses related to compounding unit and accounting"},
{"id":23,"company":"Thermon Group Holdings, Inc.","risk_score":10,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"No known accounting issues"},
{"id":24,"company":"Plug Power Inc.","risk_score":85,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"FY2019 10-K restated in 2021 for errors; SEC investigation and material weakness"},
{"id":25,"company":"Welbilt, Inc.","risk_score":80,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated 2016-2018 for improper accounting; SEC enforcement action"},
{"id":26,"company":"Gentex Corporation","risk_score":5,"knows_later_problems":false,"basis":"Clean, conservative reporting; no known issues"},
{"id":27,"company":"TheMaven, Inc.","risk_score":90,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Late 2018 10-K, restatements, material weaknesses and SEC investigation of accounting"},
{"id":28,"company":"Malvern Bancshares, Inc.","risk_score":75,"knows_later_problems":true,"basis":"Restated FY2020 financials related to loan classification and troubled debt restructuring; delayed filings"}]
